propositions: Bridge fsck reported four unbound Jira issues (REB-806, REB-807, REB-808, and one additional) with missing forward/reverse binding-store entries despite exact identity matches with local code_review artifacts.

Three unbound Jira issues (REB-806, REB-807, REB-808) have exact matching local code_review artifacts by summary, description, revision, PASS decision, and rebar-id label but lack binding-store entries.

Binding repair must atomically restore forward/reverse mappings via BindingStore.bind_confirm under rebar._store.lock.write_lock and publish through commit_and_push_tickets_branch(strict=True) without creating, archiving, or transitioning any tickets.
Post-repair verification must confirm bidirectional mapping for all three pairs and that bridge fsck reports zero alerting binding_drift and store_integrity findings.
